templateVersions.content:
Generate optimal travel destination based on: 1. Budget: {!$Input:Budget} (e.g., $500, $2000, $5000) 2. Available trip duration: {!$Input:Trip_Duration} (e.g., weekend, 5 days, 2 weeks) 3. Preferred environment: {!$Input:Environment} (e.g., mountains, beach, city, desert)
Analyze destinations that: - Fit completely within the specified budget (including accommodation, food, activities) - Maximize experience quality for the available time - Match the desired environment type - Consider current seasonal factors for optimal experience - Evaluate safety conditions for travelers
Response format must be exactly: "Recommended destination: [DESTINATION] Estimated cost: [COST RANGE] Ideal visit duration: [DAYS] Best time to visit: [SEASON/MONTHS] Safety rating: [HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW] Top 3 attractions: [ATTRACTION 1], [ATTRACTION 2], [ATTRACTION 3] Recommended hotels: [HOTEL 1], [HOTEL 2], [HOTEL 3] Must-try local foods: [FOOD 1], [FOOD 2], [FOOD 3]"
No additional explanations, alternatives, or commentary should be included.
